breakingChanges: Route module meta functions no longer receive the deprecated data argument (also matches[i].data); use loaderData on MetaArgs and each match
Middleware is always enabled; the future.v8_middleware flag was removed and passing it in react-router.config.ts is an error
The react-router-dom package was removed; import from react-router and react-router/dom
Requires Node >=22.22.0 and React and React DOM >=19.2.7; @react-router/dev supports Vite ^7 or ^8

context7.note: Unversioned /remix-run/react-router (tracks main) returned v8 content: the meta data to loaderData upgrade guide, the v8 CHANGELOG removals and the always-on middleware types. Its tagged versions stop at 7.9.4 and /websites/reactrouter at 7.13.0 (npm latest is 8.5.2), so there is no 8.0.0 tag. Treat v8 coverage as partial and untagged.
